sources.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
sources.note: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning studies how planning capability is acquired and shaped through controlled pre-training, GRPO/OPD, and multi-teacher distillation. These are offline training interventions on a model, not autonomous persistent deployment-time self-modification.

sources.title: Scaling GUI Agents with Visual State Transitions
sources.note: State Transition Pretraining improves GUI agents by continually pretraining forward/inverse visual dynamics and then fine-tuning on trajectories. The evaluated model is fixed at deployment; this is world-model/post-training evidence rather than a longitudinal self-evolution object.

sources.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
sources.note: Kimi K3 is a large-scale foundation-model training and deployment report. Persistent rollout/sandbox state is infrastructure for agentic RL, not an autonomous deployed artifact that updates itself across tasks.

sources.title: ACM: Agentic Context Management for Long Horizon Tasks
sources.note: ACM gives agents tools to edit/offload/retrieve long-horizon context and later post-trains models on context-management demonstrations. Its state changes are inference-time context management and offline training, not a persistent self-evolving behavioral artifact driven by success/failure across tasks.

sources.title: WCM: World-Cognition Model for Generalizable Human-Robot Interaction
sources.note: WCM combines asynchronous embodied orchestration with a human teaching mode and converts teaching episodes/autonomous rollouts into chain-of-thought supervision to improve the model. This is human-supervised/trajectory-supervised continual training, not an autonomous persistent self-evolution mechanism isolated under same-information controls.

sources.title: Towards Dual-Brain Minimal Sufficient Representation for Vision-Language Navigation
sources.note: BrainNav studies a compact task-relevant latent representation and compressed world model for VLN. The mechanism is a static representation/world-model design, not a deployment-time artifact evolution process.

sources.title: SearchArt: Training Long-Horizon Search Agent with Scalable Synthetic and Verified Task
sources.note: SearchArt contains a strong governance component: a self-evolving Judge Auditor stores criteria, known hacking patterns, rules, and examples in an external Audit Skill; proposed updates are admitted only after frozen regression, adversarial, and clean controls satisfy explicit recall/FPR/Macro-F1/regression thresholds, otherwise they are rolled back and revised. This is exactly versioned feedback-guided audit-skill maintenance under external validation. It supports evaluator governance and rollback controls, but does not demonstrate a same-information agent-specific residual beyond corrective skill/program maintenance and verifier-exogeneity models.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: Verifier provenance, task truth, history, observations, and validation criteria are observable; no modification-dependency residual beyond verifier-exogeneity/information-limit models is shown.
The paper explicitly uses frozen/adversarial/clean external stress tests; no contamination-induced residual beyond self-generated-verification and external-test controls is isolated.

sources.title: AgentOmnia: Scaling Agentic Models for Full-Scenario Applications
sources.note: AgentOmnia coordinates task synthesis, SFT, online agentic RL, evaluation, and targeted improvement from PRDs. It is an end-to-end training/product-improvement pipeline; the source does not isolate a deployment-time persistent artifact with a new self-evolution causal primitive.

sources.title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
sources.note: IDEAgent explicitly treats research ideation as quality-diversity search under a fixed discovery budget, maintaining active/historical/rejected memories and idea lineages while repairing and refining proposals. Yield jointly thresholds quality and extracts a mutually diverse subset. This is strong Research-OS support for lineage-aware QD search, failure memory, and repair; its gains are still predictions of mature multi-objective/QD/adaptive search plus memory and evaluator design, not a new longitudinal self-evolution causal object.

sources.title: Deconstructing Off-Policy Ratios: Entropy-Scaled Trust Regions for Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
sources.note: ESTR addresses stale/off-policy data during asynchronous RL post-training using entropy-scaled trust regions. This is an optimization/training method, not autonomous persistent deployment-time self-evolution.

sources.title: World models of environment, agent and joint agent-environment systems
sources.note: This first-party abstract distinguishes environment, agent, and joint agent-environment predictive channels and defines canonical predictive-state objects. It is useful theoretical taxonomy for world-model/control analysis. The optional full text was unavailable in this refresh (HTTP 404), so no stronger empirical/mechanistic claim is made; it does not by itself establish an autonomous self-evolution intervention.

sources.title: FedAgentKE: Federated Semantic Knowledge Evolution for Heterogeneous Agents
sources.note: FedAgentKE distills local execution trajectories into semantic knowledge units, clusters and selects them by empirical utility and cross-agent transferability, deduplicates/updates a global pool, and redistributes adapted knowledge without sharing raw trajectories. The evolving object is therefore an explicit semantic memory/knowledge base whose selection and aggregation criteria are observable. Cross-framework/cross-task gains remain expressible by memory distillation, transfer learning, federated aggregation, relevance/redundancy, and utility-based selection; no same-information irreducible co-evolution state is isolated.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: No residual is shown after matching knowledge count, semantic relevance, redundancy/complementarity, context budget, backbone, and observable utilization.
No preregistered matched factorial demonstrates a non-additive co-evolution interaction beyond expert/knowledge-set quality, aggregation, and routing/allocation.

sources.title: Addressing the Orchestration Gap in Generalist Robots via Physical Agency
sources.note: Pigey supplies high-level planning, decomposition, memory, routing, verification, and recovery over frozen VLA/skill backends without post-training. This is strong component evidence that orchestration can recover substantial task-level capability at inference time, but it is a workflow/control architecture rather than an evolving persistent scientific object.

sources.title: The World Model Remembers, the Actor Forgets: Dream Rehearsal for Continual Model-Based RL
sources.note: Dream Rehearsal is the strongest mechanism source in r4. Under never-clear replay, pre-registered probes show the world model retains old-task reward/value/termination information while the actor forgets. With the world model frozen and identical imagined rollouts, RL-in-imagination fails to recover a lost skill in 0/3 seeds whereas supervised self-imitation succeeds in 3/3, and interleaved graded dream rehearsal retains four- and eight-task chains with no task labels or parameter growth. This is a real same-data update-channel result, but the source itself locates the effect in the policy-gradient/continual-RL channel and names ordinary plasticity/primacy/optimization hypotheses still requiring variance, critic, and entropy ablations. It therefore identifies a valuable continual-learning mechanism rather than an irreducible agent self-evolution state under the current durable gates. Preserve as a watch seed only.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: A scientific reopen would require identical frozen world-model state, imagined trajectories/rewards/values, actor initialization/capacity, update count, and compute, plus a source-grounded structural variable that forces opposite retention/recovery predictions beyond strongest continual-RL plasticity, optimization-channel, regularization, and supervised-rehearsal baselines. BC-versus-RL algorithm choice alone is not such a residual.

sources.title: Skillware: A Software Ontology and Engineering Lifecycle for Persistent Behavioral Artifacts
sources.note: Skillware formalizes persistent behavioral artifacts as independently addressable software units with behavioral primacy, software identity, Agent Host activation, version/provenance, and lifecycle continuity through maintenance/rollback/removal. This strongly supports the Research-OS artifact identity and lifecycle boundary. Because version and executable semantics are explicitly observable software state, it reinforces rather than breaks the existing versioned/nonstationary-treatment reduction.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: Observable artifact identity/version/executable mapping must be supplied equally to the strongest versioned/nonstationary treatment baseline; Skillware adds software engineering structure, not a new causal primitive.

sources.title: ResearchArena: Evaluating Sabotage and Monitoring in Automated AI R&D
sources.note: ResearchArena is strong AI-R&D control evidence: it separates embedded artifact sabotage from independent sandbox sabotage and varies monitor access to executable artifact probes and chain-of-thought. Artifact execution can materially help, yet training-data sabotage remains difficult and monitors fail through surface-only inspection, anomaly rationalization, or wrong probes. These results support executable-artifact inspection and externally grounded active monitoring. They do not establish a longitudinal self-evolution variable beyond monitor information/access, active testing, and control-evaluation models.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: No same-information agent-specific residual is shown after matching treatment, monitoring state, task distribution, artifact/trace access, and probe budget.
Detection gaps change with evaluator/monitor-visible evidence and active probe access; no identical-information opposite prediction beyond information/proxy misspecification is established.
